Chowpatty Field Trip
text: Today our fun day in the sun shined brighter than any other Chowpatty trip we have ever had. After the children shook off the sand and mud and were wrapped up in their towels, we went to the main road where we were showered with barakaat. The children and all those present were blessed with Aqa Moula TUS’s Deedaar sharaf, as Moula TUS’s car slowly ambled by, with Moula TUS blessing each and every child with a heart warming nazar mubarak that each one is never likely to forget. Thus, our exciting day at the beach turned into an unexpected remarkable experience that we will cherish forever.
